notes: Hub litert-community/granite-4.1-8b (upload commit 99579c31). The clean re-measurement of the shipped files (2026-10-15, CPU pass 20:42-21:10 JST, GPU pass 22:05-22:32 JST) = the Hub card's Mac table. litert-lm 0.18.0 CLI benchmark, --cache no, 1024-token prefill / 256 decode / context 2048, one warmup then the mean of 3 iterations; two passes per file in ABBA order (int8, int4, int4, int8), each run in its own quiet window (8 windows released rc=0), the batch with no export or quantize job beside it, the CPU runs behind a RAM gate (reclaimable >= 70 GB x 3) and a swap guard. Cells = the median of the two passes (per-pass values in metrics). GPU = WebGPU on Metal; the verbose run of the same bytes on 2026-10-14 delegated all 7 decoder signatures whole to LITERT_WEBGPU (1860 / 1661 / 1693 nodes) - not printed in these runs, so the delegation cells are null here. The first measurement of 2026-10-14 (not on a quiet machine) is not entered; it is within 0.3-0.7 % (GPU, CPU int4) of these cells.
quantization: int8 dynamic on linears, float activations; GPU-composite graph (odml.cache_update / odml.runtime_bmm)
